events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Travis Kelce, Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs have faced their share of challenges this season. The two-time defending AFC champions are peaking at the right time for another playoff push.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kelce's OT touchdown gives Chiefs 34-28 win over Chargers

headlines.shortLinkText: Taylor helps Colts turn table on Patriots with 27-17 victory

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.shortLinkText: Cooper Kupp's 2 TD catches carry Rams past Seahawks 20-10

headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts has 3 TDs, Eagles come back to beat Washington
